summary: The agent correctly frames the binary classification task and sets up a robust Stratified K-Fold cross-validation scheme with three distinct gradient boosting models. However, it fails to perform any explicit data cleaning and combines the final predictions using a naive, unweighted average. Furthermore, the agent never computes or reports the out-of-fold validation scores, completely obscuring the model's expected performance.
